/*
        // Reads a file line by line, starting and stopping at different parts of the file - REWRITE AND MAYBE COMBINE INTO ABOVE?
        // Arguments:
        //   fileToOpen: the file to work with
        //   doSpecial: do something with the text in the file (_no OR _addNewLine OR _convertMarkdown OR _removeEmptyLines)
        //   startLine: line to start at (_first OR specific line)
        //   startAfterLine: start reading after this line (_unused OR specific line)
        //   stopLine: stop reading at this line (_unused OR specific line)
        public static string ReadFileLinesToString (string fileToOpen, string doSpecial, string startLine, string startAfterLine, string stopLine)
        {
            // Setup a bunch of stuff.
            int lineCount = 0;  // Better names, and do we need all of these?
            bool startReading = false;
            string breakType;
            string lineToRead;
            string workingString = string.Empty;
            System.IO.StreamReader fileToRead = new System.IO.StreamReader(fileToOpen);

            // Read the file and do stuff!
            while ((lineToRead = fileToRead.ReadLine()) != null)
            {
                // If the stop line has been reached, exit
                if (String.Equals(lineToRead, stopLine))
                {
                    break;
                }

                // Start reading at the start of the file OR at the start line
                if ((String.Equals(startLine, "_first")) || (String.Equals(startLine, lineToRead)))
                {
                    startReading = true;
                }

                // If we are reading the file
                if (startReading)
                {
                    // Do some specific things
                    switch (doSpecial)
                    {
                        // Copy the file into a string
                        case "_no":
                            workingString = workingString + lineToRead;
                            lineCount++;
                            break;

                        // Copy the file into a string, adding a newline after each line - COMBINE WITH BELOW?
                        case "_add\n":
                            workingString = workingString + lineToRead + "\n";
                            lineCount++;
                            break;

                        // Copy the file into a string, adding a carriage return and newline after each line - COMBINE WITH BELOW?
                        case "_add\r\n":
                            workingString = workingString + lineToRead + "\r\n";
                            lineCount++;
                            break;

                        // Copy the file into a string, adding a newline after each line - COMBINE WITH BELOW? OR REMOVE SINCE IT IS ABOVE?
                        case "_addNewLine":
                            workingString = workingString + lineToRead + "\n";
                            lineCount++;
                            break;

                            workingString = workingString + lineToRead + breakType;

                            lineCount++;
                            break;

                        // Copy the file into a string, removing any empty lines
                        case "removeEmptyLines":
                            if (lineToRead != string.Empty)
                            {
                                workingString = workingString + lineToRead + "\n";
                                lineCount++;
                            }
                            break;

                        default:
                            break;
                    }
                }

                // Start recording after the line we just read
                if (String.Equals(lineToRead, startAfterLine))
                {
                    startReading = true;
                }
            }

            // If marking down, wrap the final string in special CSS code // REPLACE WITH CSS
            if (doSpecial == "_convertMarkup")
            {
                //string fontCodes = "<font face=\"" + GVar.confVar["markdownFontFace"] + "\" size=\"" + GVar.confVar["markdownFontSize"] + "\">\n";
                string htmlStart = WithFiles.ReadFileLinesToString(GVar.confVar["pagebuilderStart"], "_add\n", "_first", "_unused", "_unused");
                string htmlEnd = WithFiles.ReadFileLinesToString(GVar.confVar["pagebuilderEnd"], "_add\n", "_first", "_unused", "_unused");
                workingString = htmlStart + workingString + htmlEnd;
            }

            // Close the file, and return the string
            fileToRead.Close();
            return workingString;
        }

    */

DoDICTIONARY.CS

    // WithDictionaries [140804]
// Do different things with dictionaries.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Roundhouse
{
    class WithDictionaries
    {
        // Put the values of a multidimentional array into a dictionary, mostly used to create easy to read key=value pairs
        public static Dictionary<string, string> MultiArrayToDictionary(string[,] arrayToUse)
        {
            // New dictionary to do the work on
            Dictionary<string, string> workingDictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();

            // Iterate through the passed array, and add the values to a dictionary.
            for (int keyCount = 0; keyCount < arrayToUse.GetLength(0); keyCount++)
            {
                workingDictionary.Add(arrayToUse[keyCount, 0], arrayToUse[keyCount, 1]);
            }
            return workingDictionary;
        }

        // Put values into a dictionary, overwriting if they exist, and adding if they don't. - COMBINE THIS WITH ABOVE?
        public static Dictionary<string, string> MultiArrayToOverwriteDictionary(string[,] arrayToUse, Dictionary<string, string> dictionaryToUse)
        {
            // Iterate through the passed array, and add or replace the values to a dictionary.
            for (int keyCount = 0; keyCount < arrayToUse.GetLength(0); keyCount++)
            {
                //If the current key exists, update the value.
                if (dictionaryToUse.ContainsKey(arrayToUse[keyCount, 0]))
                {
                    dictionaryToUse[arrayToUse[keyCount, 0]] = arrayToUse[keyCount, 1];
                }
                // If the current key does not exist, add the key=value pair to the dictionary.
                else
                {
                    dictionaryToUse.Add(arrayToUse[keyCount, 0], arrayToUse[keyCount, 1]);
                }
            }
            return dictionaryToUse;
        }

        // Get variables from configuration files, and put them in a dictionary. If multiple configuration files exist,
        // variables can be overwritten.
        public static Dictionary<string, string> ConfFileToDic(string splitAt, string doSpecial, string confType, string confName)
        {
            // Create some working variables for the passed configuration file, read the numnber of lines to get the number of
            // elements for an array for the values, create the array, then read the config file into the array.
            Dictionary<string, string> workingDic = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            int numElements = WithFiles.CountFileLines(confName, "_config");
            string[,] workingConfVars = new string[numElements, 2];
            workingConfVars = WithFiles.ReadFileLinesToMultiArray(confName, splitAt, doSpecial, numElements, 2);

            // Put the variables into a dictionary
            switch (confType)
            {
                // Put the base config values into the global dictionary.
                case "_base":
                    workingDic = WithDictionaries.MultiArrayToDictionary(workingConfVars);
                    break;

                // Put the override config values into the global dictionary. In some cases these values will
                // already exist in the dictionary from the default configuration file, in which case the default
                // value will be overwritten. Any values that only exist in the override configuration are added
                // to the dictionary.
                case "_override":
                    workingDic = WithDictionaries.MultiArrayToOverwriteDictionary(workingConfVars, GVar.confVar);
                    break;

                default:
                    break;
            }
            return workingDic;
        }
    }
}

    */

/*  Send                                160214 */

using System.Net.Mail;

namespace AO
{
    internal class DoEmail
    {
        /// <summary>Send an email</summary>
        public static void Send()
        {
            MailMessage mailMessageToSend = new MailMessage();
            SmtpClient SmtpServer = new SmtpClient("smtp.gmail.com");

            mailMessageToSend.From = new MailAddress("from");
            mailMessageToSend.To.Add("service-desk@abcd.com");
            mailMessageToSend.Subject = "Test Mail";
            mailMessageToSend.Body = "THIS IS A TEST!";

            SmtpServer.Port = 587;
            SmtpServer.Credentials = new System.Net.NetworkCredential("username", "password");
            SmtpServer.EnableSsl = true;

            SmtpServer.Send(mailMessageToSend);
        }
    }
}

FTP
============================================


using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Text;

namespace AO
{
    public class DoFTP
    {
        public static void test()
        {
            // Get the object used to communicate with the server.
            FtpWebRequest request = (FtpWebRequest)WebRequest.Create("ftp://aprettycoolprogram.com/public_shtml");
            request.Method = WebRequestMethods.Ftp.UploadFile;

            // This example assumes the FTP site uses anonymous logon.
            request.Credentials = new NetworkCredential("test@aprettycoolprogram.com", "brianthomas");
            // Copy the contents of the file to the request stream.

            StreamReader sourceStream = new StreamReader(@"z:\test.txt");
            byte[] fileContents = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(sourceStream.ReadToEnd());
            sourceStream.Close();
            request.ContentLength = fileContents.Length;
            Stream requestStream = request.GetRequestStream();
            requestStream.Write(fileContents, 0, fileContents.Length);
            requestStream.Close();
            FtpWebResponse response = (FtpWebResponse)request.GetResponse();
            Console.WriteLine("Upload File Complete, status {0}", response.StatusDescription);
            response.Close();
        }
    }
}

GVAR
============================================

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace AO
{
    public class GVar
    {
        // Application globals
        private static string _assemblyName; public static string AssemblyName { get { return _assemblyName; } set { _assemblyName = value; } }

        // Manifest globals
        private static bool _developmentMode; public static bool DevelopmentMode { get { return _developmentMode; } set { _developmentMode = value; } }
        private static string _helpdeskMode; public static string HelpdeskMode { get { return _helpdeskMode; } set { _helpdeskMode = value; } }
        private static string _avatoolVersion; public static string AvatoolVersion { get { return _avatoolVersion; } set { _avatoolVersion = value; } }
        private static string _avatoolBuild; public static string AvatoolBuild { get { return _avatoolBuild; } set { _avatoolBuild = value; } }
        private static string _defaultEnvironmentName; public static string DefaultEnvironmentName { get { return _defaultEnvironmentName; } set { _defaultEnvironmentName = value; } }
        private static string _defaultEnvironmentIP; public static string DefaultEnvironmentIP { get { return _defaultEnvironmentIP; } set { _defaultEnvironmentIP = value; } }
        private static string _sessionUsername; public static string SessionUsername { get { return _sessionUsername; } set { _sessionUsername = value; } }
        private static string _sessionPassword; public static string SessionPassword { get { return _sessionPassword; } set { _sessionPassword = value; } }

        /// <summary>Load settings.</summary>
        /// <param name="settings">The settings.</param>
        public static void Load(Dictionary<string, string> settings, string varType)
        {
            switch (varType)
            {
                case "setting":
                    GVar.DevelopmentMode = Convert.ToBoolean(settings["developmentMode"]);
                    GVar.HelpdeskMode = settings["helpdeskMode"];
                    GVar.AvatoolVersion = settings["avatoolVersion"];
                    GVar.AvatoolBuild = settings["avatoolBuild"];
                    GVar.DefaultEnvironmentName = settings["defaultEnvironmentName"];
                    GVar.DefaultEnvironmentIP = settings["defaultEnvironmentIP"];
                    break;

                case "credential":
                    //GVar.SessionUsername = credentials["sessionUsername"];
                    //GVar.SessionPassword = credentials["sessionPassword"];
                    break;

                case "application":
                    GVar.AssemblyName = "AVATOOL";
                    break;

                default:
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace AO
{
    public class DoAPCP
    {
        /// <summary>Embedded</summary>
        /// <param name="assemblyName"></param>
        /// <param name="manifestType"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        public static List<string> ReadSettingManifest(string assemblyName)
        {
            return DoList.Remove(DoFile.ToList("APCP.Manifest.Setting", assemblyName));
        }

        public static List<string> ReadCredentialManifest(string assemblyName)
        {
            return DoList.Remove(DoFile.ToList("APCP.Manifest.Credential", assemblyName));
        }

    }
}

using System.Net;

namespace AO
{
    public class DoWeb
    {
        public static string SourceToString(string sourceURL)
        {
            string webpageSourceAsString = new WebClient().DownloadString(sourceURL);
            return webpageSourceAsString;
        }
    }
}
